Our team's Shiny app links three charts from Abela's *Chart Suggestions: A Thought-Starter* (2006): **Chart 9**, a scatter chart; **Chart 18**, a bubble chart; and **Chart 3**, a bar chart we chose because the Happy Planet Index gives one score per country across more than 130 countries. Drag a box on the scatter chart to highlight those countries in the bubble chart and rank them in the bar chart; press play on the year slider to animate 2006–2025.

```{=html}
<iframe
  src="https://REPLACE-WITH-CONNECT-CLOUD-URL"
  title="Happy Planet Index explorer: scatter, bubble and bar charts, 2006 to 2025"
  width="100%" height="1300"
  style="border: 1px solid #d0d4d8; border-radius: 8px;"
  loading="lazy"></iframe>
```

If the app does not load here, [open it in a new tab](https://REPLACE-WITH-CONNECT-CLOUD-URL). An idle app can take a little while to start.
